records.title: Inverse-designed nanophotonic neural network accelerators for ultra-compact optical computing
records.reason: Photonic hardware is experimentally applied to MNIST/MedNIST image classification; no LLM inference, serving, or token/KV optimization is studied.

records.title: PromptHash: Affinity-Prompted Collaborative Cross-Modal Learning for Adaptive Hashing Retrieval
records.reason: PromptHash optimizes image-text retrieval representation learning and hashing; its efficiency is retrieval/storage, not LLM inference cost or latency.

records.title: ELFATT: Efficient Linear Fast Attention for Vision Transformers
records.reason: ELFATT is evaluated as a Vision Transformer attention operator for image/long-range vision tasks; no LLM inference implementation or serving evaluation is established.

records.title: AutoPT: How Far Are We From the Fully Automated Web Penetration Testing?
records.reason: 一次出版社ページ https://doi.org/10.1109/TIFS.2025.3601343 を開いたが、読める要旨/本文を取得できず、入力要旨だけで対象外とは判定しない。一次証拠を照合できないためborderline。

records.title: GaGA: Towards Interactive Global Geolocation Assistant
records.reason: GaGA is a geolocation assistant/dataset contribution focused on accuracy; it proposes no compute, memory, or serving optimization for VLM inference.
